summary: Orla Mining Ltd. filed a Form 6-K with Exhibit 99.1, a Notice of Special Meeting of Shareholders scheduled for July 22, 2026, with a record date of June 15, 2026. The filing is a routine meeting notice to Canadian securities regulatory authorities regarding meeting logistics and voting security details (common shares, CUSIP 68634K106). No transaction, business combination, or special-situations event is described. The document contains no terms, recommendations, or mechanics associated with acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, or other special situations. This is purely a regulatory meeting notice.
